learning_objective: 💡 Uncover the invisible forces of theatre! Learn how clever lighting and immersive soundscapes control the mood, focus, and emotion of a play.

key_vocabulary.hindi_meaning: स्पॉटलाइट (मंच पर किसी एक व्यक्ति या स्थान पर केंद्रित तेज़ रोशनी)
ध्वनि-विज्ञान (किसी हॉल में ध्वनि के गूंजने और फैलने का तरीका)
ध्वनि परिदृश्य (नाटक का माहौल बनाने के लिए बैकग्राउंड आवाज़ों का मिश्रण)
जेल (रंगीन पारदर्शी शीट जिसे लाइट के आगे लगाकर रोशनी का रंग बदला जाता है)
इशारा (वह निश्चित संकेत जिस पर लाइट या साउंड बदलना होता है)

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Lighting does more than just let us see the actors. It directs the audience's focus (visibility), establishes the time and place (is it noon or midnight?), and profoundly shapes the emotional mood of the scene.

Different lights have different jobs. 'Spotlights' highlight a specific actor, 'Wash lights' fill the whole stage with an even glow, and 'Gobos' are stencils placed over lights to project patterns (like leaf shadows or window panes).
Lighting designers use colored 'Gels' to evoke feelings. Warm colors (amber, orange) feel cozy or intense, while cool colors (blue, pale green) feel distant, sad, or eerie.

Sound isn't just actors talking. A soundscape includes background ambience (crickets chirping, city traffic), Foley effects (footsteps, doors slamming), and the background musical score that heightens emotional tension.

Theatre requires perfect timing. A 'Cue' is a signal for the tech team. When an actor flips a prop light switch, the lighting operator must hit their cue at the exact millisecond to make the stage lights turn on, creating a seamless illusion.

fun_activity.title: 🔦 Shadow Storytelling
fun_activity.instructions: Take a flashlight in a dark room. Try lighting your face from below (under the chin) - you look scary! Now light it from above - you look dramatic. Notice how simply moving the angle of light completely changes your character's vibe.

exam_tips: 📌 Know the primary functions of stage lighting: Visibility, Focus, Mood/Atmosphere, and Modeling (giving 3D form to actors).
📌 What is a 'Gobo'? Answer: A physical stencil placed inside a lighting fixture to project a shape or pattern on the stage.
📌 Explain 'Foley art' - the reproduction of everyday sound effects added in real-time or post-production to enhance the audio quality.
quick_recap: ⭐ Sound design can define the 'where' and 'when' of a play before the curtain even opens.
⭐ The control booth is where the lighting and sound operators execute their cues during a live show.
⭐ Good light and sound design should be invisible to the audience; it should feel like a natural part of the story.
